label: new-rule retrospective reconstruction; convenience sample chosen now; not full-market or prior-live-system performance
decision: DCF median >= current close AND production SEPA Pivot_Triggered AND complete evidence/risk gates

sepa_adapter.rs: 252-observation total-return percentile within fixed pilot sample; not vendor RS
sepa_adapter.contractions: range percent in three consecutive past 20-session blocks, measured at date t-1

valuation: production MonteCarloDCF on latest eligible annual same-accession SEC facts; cash CFO-capex proxy as used by project, model-interpretation caveat; net debt excludes leases to match disclosed core borrowings
publication_guard: annual filing date + 1 full calendar day; never period-end as availability
unknown_inputs: skip; never fill zero absent explicit zero fact
price_basis: Yahoo split-adjusted OHLC/volume and dividend amounts; convert to decision-date share units; immutable raw actions retained
adjustment_note: Historical split scale conversion is a unit transformation; original decision price and 2-decimal core rounding are computed in contemporaneous units.
